newsitem.title: USA: Number Nine cuts prices, upgrades driver.
newsitem.headline: Number Nine cuts prices, upgrades driver.

text.p: Number Nine Visual Technology Corp said Tuesday that it cut the price of the 9FX Reality 332 to $99 from $149.
The company said it made the move to expand market penetration for its entry-level, 64-bit graphics offering.

It also annouced the availability of a faster Windows 95 performance driver for its 9FX Reality 772 and 9FX Reality 332 line of 64-bit, 2D/3D visual accelerators targeted at business and consumer PC users.
This driver is available immediately and can be downloaded from the company's web site (http://www.nine.com).

The company sid users of both the 9FX Reality 332 and the 9FX Reality 772 line of visual accelerators can expect a 25 percent performance boost in Windows 95 performance by installing an easy-to-load driver update.

The 9FX Reality 332 is based on S3's popular S3d ViRGE graphics controller and is equipped with 2-megabytes of fast EDO DRAM. The board supports display resolutions up to 1280 x 1024 at 256 colors, 1024 x 768 at 65K colors or 800 x 600 at 16.8 million colors.
